episodes.title: Legenden bliver til
episodes.summary: When a police informant following a drug smuggler is murdered, an inexperienced cadet is enlisted to go undercover and get the details of the next drop.

episodes.title: Tilbage fra Dubai
episodes.summary: Ashley attends a soirée held by Sara, and Miran voices his suspicions about the women's new-found friendship. Folke requests a warrant for a wiretap.

episodes.title: Blod og balloner
episodes.summary: An abrupt message from Ashley forces Sara to try a new tactic. Meanwhile, Miran pitches an idea for a different kind of collaboration with the jeweler.

episodes.title: Ingen steder at flygte hen
episodes.summary: After a somber gathering, Miran makes a proposition to his family. Sara's diamond-grading skills — and her friendship with Ashley — are put to the test.

episodes.title: Trukket dybere ind
episodes.summary: The pressure mounts on Miran after unexpected visitors arrive, and Folke steps out of the shadows. A concerned Tea wrestles with her conscience.

episodes.title: Hvad var det, du sagde, at du hed?
episodes.summary: Folke makes Ashley an enticing offer at an impossible price. Trying to help her friend, Tea comes face-to-face with the last person she wants to see.
